Acron Aviation is seeking motivated and innovative Software Engineering interns to join our engineering teams in Phoenix, Arizona.

This full-time, onsite internship is anticipated to run May through August and provides an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge in a professional engineering environment. You will work alongside experienced engineers and contribute to the development, testing, integration, and support of software for aviation products and technologies.

Depending on the assigned location, team, and product line, you may gain experience throughout the software development lifecycle, including software requirements, design, coding, debugging, verification, integration testing, problem investigation, technical documentation, and process improvement. The source requisition identifies these activities as central to the internship experience. 


What You Will Do:
• Responsibilities may vary based on your assigned location, team, product line, academic background, and current business needs. Examples include: 
• Work under the guidance of experienced software engineers and technical team members. 
• Assist with interpreting, developing, and implementing software requirements. 
• Support software design, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation. 
• Develop or update software requirements-based test cases and verification procedures. 
• Participate in software unit, integration, and system-level testing. 
• Support pre-integration and post-integration testing activities. 
• Assist with software verification and branch coverage analysis. 
• Investigate, analyze, and help resolve internal and external software problem reports. 
• Document test results, technical findings, recommendations, and corrective actions. 
• Support the development and maintenance of internal software tools. 
• Use configuration management and change management tools in accordance with established engineering practices. 
• Collaborate with Systems, Electrical, Mechanical, Test, Manufacturing, Quality, and other Software Engineering teams. 
• Participate in technical reviews and software process improvement activities. 
• Contribute to the development and support of embedded software, application software, test software, or engineering tools. 
• Perform other software engineering assignments aligned with your academic background and the needs of the assigned team.

Required Qualifications:
• Currently enrolled in an accredited bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. 
• Expected to have completed at least two years of undergraduate study before the internship begins. 
• Foundational knowledge of software development concepts, programming, and problem-solving. 
• Academic, project, or practical programming experience in at least one programming language. 
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. 
• Effective verbal communication, technical writing, and presentation skills. 
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team-based engineering environment. 
• Ability to learn new programming languages, development tools, technologies, and engineering processes. 
• Ability to work full-time and onsite at the assigned Acron Aviation location for the duration of the internship 
• This position may require access to information, technology, software, or hardware that is subject to U.S. export control laws and regulations. To comply with these requirements, applicants must qualify as a US Person.

Preferred Qualifications:
• Coursework, project experience, prior internship experience, or knowledge in one or more of the following areas: 
• C, C++, C#, Python, SQL, or other relevant programming languages 
• Object-oriented programming and software design principles 
• Embedded software or real-time systems 
• Software requirements and requirements-based testing 
• Software verification, debugging, and integration testing 
• Unit testing, code coverage, or automated testing 
• Configuration management, change management, or version-control tools 
• Linux, QNX, VxWorks, Integrity, Windows, or other operating environments 
• Qt or other user-interface development frameworks 
• Processor-based or hardware-integrated software development 
• Technical documentation and software design artifacts 
• Aerospace, aviation, or another regulated industry 
• Agile or other software development methodologies 
• Technical clubs, programming competitions, research, or relevant academic projects

Equal Opportunity Statement
Acron Aviation is proud to be an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to treating all employees and applicants with respect and dignity and to maintaining a workplace free from unlawful discrimination. All applicants will be considered for employment regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or other related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other legally protected characteristic.
 
Additional Information:
Acron Aviation maintains a drug-free workplace and conducts pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks, where allowed by law. Acron Aviation is an E-Verify employer

 At  ModMed , we’re not just building software—we’re reimagining the healthcare experience. Founded in 2010 by a practicing physician and a successful tech entrepreneur, we took a radically different approach:  we hired doctors and taught them how to code.  This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care.
 
 A Culture of Excellence 
 
 When you join ModMed, you’re joining an award-winning team recognized for innovation and employee satisfaction.   From our global headquarters in Boca Raton Florida, and extensive employee base in Hyderabad India, we are a team of 4,500+ passionate problem-solvers on a mission to increase medical practice success and improve patient outcomes:

• Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work 
 
• 2025 Globee Business Awards:  Gold Globee for “Technology Team of the Year”
 
• 2025 Black Book Awards:  Ranked #1 EHR in 11 Specialties
 
• Florida Venture Forum:  Venture-Backed Company of the Year
 
 We are growing fast, thinking big, and we are just getting started.
 
 Ready to modernize medicine with us? 

 Job Description Summary: 
 ModMed's Product Development team eagerly welcomes interns who are passionate about pursuing a career in Software Engineering. We are a dynamic team of experts in Java, .Net, Mobile (iOS), and AI/ML Engineering, guided by the principles in AI Forward Software Development Lifecycle. Our software operates seamlessly within the Amazon Web Services cloud environment.
 Here, you'll engage in meaningful, real-world projects that leave a lasting impact. ModMed Interns have the opportunity to transform their ideas and enthusiasm into tangible accomplishments. You'll cultivate essential skills and gain hands-on experience while collaborating with some of the industry's most exceptional talents. Our dedicated team of engineers and architects will mentor and challenge you every step of the way.

 Your Role: 
 
• Tackle Complex Challenges: Engage with and solve intricate problems, pushing the boundaries of your skills and knowledge. 
• Contribute Across the Tech Spectrum: Be an integral part of our engineering projects, making contributions to the frontend, backend, and/or mobile development efforts. 
• Witness Your Impact: Experience the gratification of seeing your code come to life, as it's deployed and utilized by both internal and external customers. 
• Collaborate Across Functions: Join forces with cross-functional teams to provide comprehensive system support, gaining valuable exposure to various aspects of our operations. 
 Ideal Candidate Criteria for Summer 2027: 
 
• Educational Background: You are currently enrolled in a Computer Science program (or a related field) or pursuing your Masters or PhD in Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence. 
• Availability: Ability to work at our headquarters in Boca Raton, Florida, on a hybrid basis during the internship and willingness to commit to relocation post-graduation. 
• Academic Excellence: You maintain a GPA of 3.5 or higher and have experience with Microservices, Java, MySQL, and Angular. Strong preference for candidates with experience in streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka), containerization, caching, Web sockets, and AWS. 
• Passion for AI Development Lifecycle: You're a champion of AI Forward Deployment and have experience with Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar AI development tools. 
• Curiosity and Problem-Solving Skills: You approach challenges with curiosity and are skilled at finding solutions. 
• Self-Motivated & Adaptable: You're a self-starter who thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative environment. 

 Teams Hiring Interns: 
 Interns will have the opportunity to join specialized groups across Product Development. To help you make an educated decision on where you'd like to make an impact, here is a breakdown of our teams:

 Architecture & Platform Engineering 
 
• Team Function: Documenting proposed architectural designs, maintaining technical best practices, and building scalable cloud infrastructure to empower development teams. 
• Potential Projects: Adding features to the Canopy platform for custom YAML infrastructure management, driving toil reduction through automation, and handling infrastructure migrations. 
• Tech Stack: AWS, Java, Python, and scripting (Bash/PowerShell). 
• Must-Haves: Familiarity with cloud computing, networking principles, and infrastructure as code (IaC) concepts. Nice-to-haves include Golang, Terraform, and EKS. 
 Software Engineering (EMA, GI & Patient Engagement) 
 
• Team Function: Building cloud-native services, APIs, and modern patient experiences (scheduling, messaging) using AI-assisted workflows as standard practice. 
• Potential Projects: Integrating AWS managed services (ElastiCache, OpenSearch, API Gateway), developing AI-powered healthcare agent automations, and implementing end-to-end CI/CD regression test suites. 
• Tech Stack: Java, C#/.NET, React/modern front-end frameworks, Docker, Databricks, and AI coding assistants. 
• Must-Haves: Distributed systems fundamentals (REST APIs, pub/sub, caching), Git PR-based workflows, and a strong builder mindset for agentic development and prompt engineering. 
 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) 
 
• Team Function: Maintaining the stability and performance of large, complex systems across the ModMed portfolio. 
• Potential Projects: Enhancing continuous operations, SLAs, observability, cost management, and automation for PCI compliance. 
• Tech Stack & Must-Haves: Basic knowledge of AWS, foundational programming experience, and a collaborative approach to improving infrastructure operations. 
 Data & Analytics Engineering 
 
• Team Function: Modernizing foundational data platforms and enhancing data product offerings. 
• Potential Projects: Building scalable data pipelines and modernizing the core data architecture. 
• Tech Stack & Must-Haves: SQL, Python, and a strong grasp of data engineering basics. 
 ModMed Benefits Highlight:  At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:
 
 United States 
 
• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution, 
• 401(k):  ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep. 
• Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs, 
• Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs, 
• Company-sponsored Business Resource & Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed, 
• Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning , 
• Global presence and in-person collaboration opportunities; dog-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office-based roles and remote availability for some roles, 
• Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters. 
 
 PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (first.lastname@modmed.com). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully.  Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website .
